title: Quick Roasted Croatian Chicken Skewers
description: A high protein friendly Croatian dish featuring chicken skewers roasted to perfection with a glassy jelly glaze and a kick of Thai bird chili, shaped like nigiri for a solo dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, apple cider vinegar, honey, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
Roast the skewers in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked through
While the chicken is cooking, mix the sliced Thai bird chili with a little water to create a glaze
After the chicken has roasted for 15 minutes, brush the chili glaze over the top of each skewer
Return the skewers to the oven and continue roasting for an additional 5 minutes, or until the glaze is caramelized and sticky
Remove the skewers from the oven and garnish with chopped fresh parsley
